per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: HTTP API endpoints for Agent, Research, Search, Fetch and Browser, plus SDKs, a CLI and MCP per the pricing page

limits.value: Search is capped at 30 requests a minute and 500 an hour on the free path
Fetch is capped at 150 URLs a minute and 1,000 a day on the free path
an $8 wallet grant is one-time; Agent and Browser need funds to start, and a run under way finishes at a zero balance
